name: Sweet bamboo
summary: Sweet bamboo, nó bói in Thái. Báo Sơn La, on 19 August 2022, says the season runs from the start of April through November, longer than bitter bamboo, măng sặt, or măng lay. Peel it and boil it about 20 minutes, then dip it in chẩm chéo. The same article also eats the heart raw with herbs, stir-fries it with meat or forest greens, salads it with ban flower, simmers slices with bone, and pickles it with crushed garlic, chili, salt, and vinegar for a few days. It is sold at the city market.
taste: Báo Sơn La calls it crisp, sweet, and cool, and says bitter bamboo, măng vầu, măng mai, and măng bương carry a he or bitter note that this shoot does not.
howToEat: Boiled with chẩm chéo, raw with herbs, stir-fried, in a salad with ban flower, simmered with bone, or pickled with garlic, chili, salt, and vinegar. The morning phở table in town may already have the pickle. A market hour and a price are Check on arrival.
where: The city market, where Thái sellers lay it out, and the ethnic kitchens the article names without a shop. Season: the start of April through November.
seoTitle: Mang boi in Son La — sweet bamboo from April to November
